item.title: Asahi Linux Experience
item.description:
Hello! I got my first Mac and used macOS. I am a tiling window manager fan, so I wanted a layout like it for macOS but it was too complex. So, I installed Linux on it. Crazy, right?

Installation

Firstly, I ran Asahi Install Command and followed the introductions. And something like Calamares popped up and I finished the installation.

After Installation

I tested it a little bit, it’s really awesome. A lot of packages and copr repositories support Asahi, which is so good. I installed Hyprland on it, now it works really good.

item.title: Best Mac Apps
item.description:
Hello and welcome to my blog!

In this post, we’ll review some macOS apps!

Raycast

This could be my favorite app. It has functionality ranging from shortcuts to apps all the way to a simple Spotlight.

For example, you can use it just as a basic Spotlight, or with plugins, you can unlock endless possibilities.

For instance, I installed the Homebrew plugin for Homebrew and set the Search function to Command+Shift+K. By pressing that shortcut, typing the app name, and hitting Return twice, I can install the app. Isn’t that super easy?
